en.headline: Siobhan Haughey defends Asian Games 100m freestyle title
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer won in 52.45 seconds in Tokyo on Tuesday, her second individual gold of the Nagoya Games after the 200m freestyle.
body: Hong Kong swimmer Siobhan Haughey retained the Asian Games women's 100 metres freestyle title on Tuesday, finishing in 52.45 seconds at the Tokyo Aquatics Centre.

China's Yu Yiting took silver in 53.21 seconds and Cheng Yujie bronze in 53.47, according to race reports. Hong Kong teammate Li Sum-yiu placed seventh. Haughey led after the first 25 metres and turned at halfway in 25.25 seconds.

The win followed her defence of the 200 metres freestyle on Monday and a silver in the women's 4x100 metres freestyle relay, taking her Nagoya tally to two golds and one silver. She held the Hangzhou Games title in 52.17 seconds and still owns the Asian record of 52.02.

Speaking after the race, Haughey said she was satisfied and glad her parents could watch in person at a venue where she had raced at the Tokyo Olympics without spectators. She is due back in the pool on Thursday for the 50 metres freestyle. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law congratulated her on the 100 metres gold.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運100米自由泳封后 兩日內個人第二金
zh.dek: 港隊「女飛魚」周二在東京水上運動中心以52秒45成功衛冕，繼周一200米自由泳後再奪金牌。
body: 香港泳手何詩蓓周二在愛知・名古屋亞運會女子100米自由泳決賽以52秒45奪金，成功衛冕上屆杭州亞運冠軍。
內地選手余依婷以53秒21獲銀牌，程玉潔 53秒47得銅牌。港隊另一選手李芯愉排第七。何詩蓓開賽後迅速領先，50米轉身時間為25秒25。
這是她本屆亞運第二面個人金牌，加上女子4x100米自由泳接力銀牌，目前累積兩金一銀。她在杭州以52秒17封后，亞洲紀錄52秒02仍由她保持。
賽後何詩蓓表示整體滿意，並高興父母能夠到場觀看；她曾在同一場館出戰東京奧運，當時未有觀眾。她周四將出戰50米自由泳。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩已祝賀她再奪金牌。
